text: good pizza. thin but delicious. good food. the flavor was immaculate. i highly recommend the cheese pizza. good for adults kids and old people. good place to eat. rona can't stop us from enjoying food. thank you for coming to my ted talk.
Did curbside pickup - food was ready when I got there and was delicious! Can't wait to go back for late night tacos and margs.

Trendy tacos! Where I come from, this place is called Bakersfield (uh, wait, they're a Bakersfield here too!) Honestly I'd say the drinks are better than and the tacos are about even with the aforementioned. My favorite drink was the, "Old Thymer" -- it was pleasantly herbal without being OTT. I tried a bite of almost every single one of the tacos... in the end my fave was the Portobello (lame, I know).

Really yummy foods. I love the thanksgiving sandwich, the meatball sandwich and the chicken teriyaki bowl. They have a homemade chili sauce that is so good I put it on almost anything. Their customer service is really good. Food took a bit long but it was worth the wait. Super yummy and fresh. Highly recommend!!

05/07/19: Food was good. Host was a jerk! He was doing paperwork and didnt even look up when greeting us (apparently smiling costs extra). We asked for a table by the water and he said one wasnt available. I pointed out two that were available. Then he said "You people make this too difficult!" He then proceeded to seat us in huff...away from the water. When I asked again about the tables we wanted he said "ok, I'll just leave the menus here and you people can go rogue." We then had to seat ourselves. Waiter was very nice, but service was slow. Will NEVER  return.

Oh my word. I got the chicken, which is a chicken shaped confection with Grand Marnier buttercream and almond flavor and fondant icing. Each bite was filled with flavor and  not just talking about the flavor of sugar. So many bakeries think sugar is the flavor and it's not. But I could taste the almond and the Grand Marnier.

The Cafe au Lait was wonderful. I guess it's the chicory but my heavens, the fist taste was crack in a cup.

Now the ambience is a combination of France and Louisiana. So adorable. There was one woman in an adorable dress that looked like she just stepped out of a 1940s movie. There is also a lovely little garden area.

My family picked up a meal from there.  It is nice that they also have meals you can take home and cook but we got the already prepared items.  They are observing safety protocols.  I had the Mexican street corn bowl with grilled shrimp that came with citrus rice, romaine, corn, black beans, cotija cheese and chile lime tajin, guacamole, a cilantro lime sauce.  The grilled shrimp had been seasoned nice and tasted quite good.  The mix of flavors in the bowl was really good and I enjoyed the meal.  The staff were friendly and helpful.

Visiting from Texas and stopped here and had the BEST COFFEE!!! I ordered a simple iced white mocha latte and it was so light but the perfect combo of sweet with a smooth taste of the coffee. The best part is their ice too!! I 100% recommend and will definitely be back to visit!!

The staff here are so friendly, professional, cheerful, and attentive. My fiancé and I had the pretzel bite appetizer and the veggie pizza. Both were delicious. They have a very large beer selection and also a couple of wines. Tip: you can park up to 4 hours for free at the tattoo shop next door.
Family owned restaurant Great home cooking, comfort food. Excellent friendly staff. A must have when in Nashville. And the owner is hot

When I travel, I NEVER go to the same place twice. Especially in NOLA, there is SO MUCH amazing food and drink to try and never enough time (or money). But this place. THIS PLACE got a second visit two days in a row! My. Freaking. Goodness. The coffee was delicious. The pastries were PHENOMENAL! Talk about melt in your mouth, slightly crispy on the outside and warm and soft on the inside, and with such a flavor that someone on the keto or paleo diet will question their conviction to avoid carbs at all cost! AND THEN THERE WAS THE BREAKFAST IN A CUP. Eggs. Grits. Bacon. Sausage. Gravy. IN A CUP. Cooked to perfection and piping hot to warm that cold belly still churning from abuse you put it through the night before on Bourbon St. This place will revive you. It will fuel you for another series of poor life choices that NOLA demands of you. It will give a pep-talk to your liver and convince him that you CAN have another drink. You CAN metabolize another 7 hurricanes. You CAN put down an extra hand grenade because your buddy is currently face first in a toilet heave hoeing yesterday's lunch (did y'all even remember to eat yesterday?) and his drink is sitting idly while you're melting in the hot humidity of a freaking swamp.

My husband and I went there last night. Ordered 2 hot dogs, 2 small drinks and a knish. Came out to be $20. Way too expensive and it was awful!!  The hot dogs were skinny and all we could taste were the buns. The knish was so hard and overdone. When I complained about that she took a knife and fork out to cut it. Being raised and from New York I know what a knish is suppose to be. You don't cut it. You pick it up and eat it. It was as hard as a rock. Needless to say, we will never go there again.
Great place was super fun! Of course prices are high but the experience is a few hours and is well worth it. Super good for an anniversary!! Staff is super nice and would 100 percent come again!

Wasabi is good. It's not the best sushi I've ever had, but it's consistent and keeps coming back. They have a great happy hour deal and an awesome discount on Tuesdays. The menu has a lot of variety, but I think I've only had most of the sushi rolls and their chicken teriyaki. I'm a fan of their bento boxes as well if you don't want to go the purely sushi route. 

I am a bit disappointed they removed their tempura ice cream from the menu, but maybe that's for the best. 

One thing that annoys me is their changing loyalty program. At first it was just a card they swiped, then you gave your phone number, and then recently they changed to another program that also requires just a phone number but they didn't properly transfer everyone over. I hope this new one is better because the last one was down a lot and they never knew how to add points on after.

Stopped in for a quick lunch while walking around downtown Indianapolis. The visit was anything but quick, but let's start with the positive. 

The food was quite good. I had the buffalo chicken sandwich and my wife had a Turkey burger. Both were very good. My wife went as far as saying it may have been the best turkey burger she had ever had. We also ordered the cheese curds as an appetizer and they were very good. 

The problem came with the service and general timing. We walked in the door at 11:15 and did not cash out until 1:25 (this was not the plan). The appetizer took quite a while to come out and because of this our food was delivered about 30 seconds after the appetizer. This made for a crowded table (2 person booth) and difficulty enjoying our food while it was hot. The worst part was the service, which was not entirely the fault of our server as she was incredibly busy with other tables. Instead, they seem to be really understaffed, which led to us seeing our server about 3-4 times in 2 hours.

The worst part, due to our server being so busy, we waited 45 mins just to have the opportunity to ask for our check. In my opinion, there are few things worse when dining out than wanting to cash out and leave and being unable to do so because your server is busy or inattentive (busy in our case).

Overall, the food was quality, they have a big menu with lots of drinks (HUGE Long Island list) but I would not come here if you are trying to grab a quick bite and go about you

Went to Bullard's American Cafe for breakfast. Great food and great service. I had a stack of 3 pancakes and they were the size of the plate. Delicious!!! The wife had a special dish of the day of caramelized waffles with ice cream and she loved it!!!

Of course, the Pub needs no extra recommendations from us but from two Irish man and woman who have visited pubs from San Francisco to Buffalo and Ireland and have been regular customer since 1987 you will be missing a great experience if you do not visit ASAP.
Forget the prices, which are from the 70's, it's the quality of the food, the ambiance and great service that make it a destination, even for us, who travel a distance.  Keep up the great tradition, Sheila

So disappointed!  We come to this place every time we r in nAshville.  For the last two years that was once a week at least for almost 6 months.  Never were we ever disappointed. Not so this visit.  Taco special was awful.  Pork was full of fat and completely un flavorful.  The brisket was runny and bland.  Not sure if we will ever go back.

I happened to come across Allora while dining at the owner's other establishment, Nene's Italian Deli; also located in Marlton. 

This place, and the owner's other establishment played an instrumental part for my family during the early part of the quarantine. Their family dinner specials were beneficial to my wife and I were adjusting to working from home with kids. Great meals at a great price.

When restrictions were slightly lifted, Allora was our second dining experience, but the first with just the wife and I. It was great to share a bottle of wine (BYOB), and enjoy this fine Italian cuisine. 

Their Chicken Parmigiana is the best around. Breaded perfectly, with a slight crunch. My next favorite is the braised beef. It's packed with flavor, and so tender that it falls apart with just the slightest touch.

We usually order penne and sausage for the kids and they love it. I've enjoyed just about everything I tried here, but that Shrimp & Crabmeat Fra Diablo is something special. 

Whenever my in-laws watch the kids, I encouraged them to order from Allora. It's great to have this establishment in close proximity.

Deanie's was our first meal after arriving in NOLA on a Thursday night.  It was lively and bustling. There seemed to be a good mix of locals and tourists.  The portions were huge and delicious!  I wish we had more than 3 people in our party to try more dishes.  I definitely recommend for a fun and tasty evening.

Disappointed in Eddie Merlot's service!! Enjoyed French Onion soup and crab legs - very good. Service was very poor. Had a fly in my drink and waiter acted like this was not a big deal. I was charged for the replacement with no apology.

Delicious! I ordered a stack of pancakes, side of ham and an omelette. The pancakes were huge,  sadly I was only able to eat one. The omelette was exactly how I ordered it. And the ham-thank you little piggie, was juicy!

This is my new favorite Pho spot in Nashville. I drive past 4-5 other pho places in Nashville everytime and come here. Truly one of the best bowls I've ever had. I've had 100+ over the last couple years. They're super friendly and attentive, always consistent. Bonus they offer 10% off if you pay cash.

Such a nice restaurant!! Both in terms of the food and the service here.

Came here with a couple of friends for a birthday and we ordered a variety of dishes. I personally got one of the soups and really enjoyed the taste. Another great dish of theirs was the Gamjatang - not too spicy but good flavours. The side dishes were amazing and the staff regularly topped up our sides. 

The service here is amazing. The staff were super accommodating when we brought a mini cake. They helped to store and provide additional cutlery for the dessert. One of the ladies here even helped me film a video of us surprising our friend. They even surprised him with a free drink!

The prices are extremely reasonable. Would definitely recommend everyone to try out the restaurant if you are in the area.

This is actually a hidden gem in the food community of holiday. They actually have Fortune cookies.theur chicken lo mein is great but the chicken fried rice meh. The best Chinese place in the area. They are polite and nice at the counter to. Overall a good eat for the weekend.

We waited for five minutes to be seated & when I FINALY had enough of being just looked at by the servers and not seated, I approached the lobby and she walked right past me & asked my BF "how many"...... ok, then we seated and a couple that came in after us got their drinkers and order taken first. We had a total of three people coming and going with out food, my BF ordered mixed fried rice that NEVER came. The owner came & apologized but said that " it was good he forgot" because it looked like we still had food left"... Really?!.... Anyways, the food was great but the service was horrible, I won't be recommending or going back.

Really love this new spot in my old neighborhood and it makes me want to come back! A place that doesn't adjust their spice level is legit!
I had the shaw muong, which was a special of the night. They were these delicious flower tapioca dumplings that were so delicious and seasoned. The highlight of the evening was our entree, the tom yum soup. This was enough to feed two people for sure but we did need extra rice! I loved how the fish, mushrooms and veggie servings were generous, the soup was spicy and flavorful and perfect to taste. I could eat this all over again!!
*That delicious pork chop dish at La Stalla is called Maiale la Stalla.  It has a little bit of kick to it but i think it is perfect.

Came in with a group of 6 we all ordered water they brought the pitcher to self serve. Order salads brought one . They didn't serve the table with respect maybe because we are Spanish?  Worst Olive Garden service ever

This place is getting 5*s for several reasons!
First of : the Avocado Egg Rolls... OHMYWORD
The grilled shrimp was fantastic as well as the cheese grits! **Real plastic straws y'all that made the frozen drinks to die for! Masks optional too. 
Seriously, I was in heaven WITH a view!

Very romantic dining experience with great food. I would like to go back but when I do I would be torn to get the same thing since it was so good or continue exploring being that they have many other options that sound great. The star of the show was their Potato Gnocchi that is served in a butter sage sauce (wow). The truffle fries were also very delicious.

I'm not a big pizza lover anyway first off
 Second the pizza was just too salty for me. It was just okay. O threw three slices out. Didn't want to get high blood pressure. This is just my opinion. Probably will Never go back.

You could never go wrong with Chick Fil A. The service is amazing and the employees are the nicest people ever. Good price for good food. I recommend the Chick Fil A nuggets or the chicken sandwich, both really amazing. Best Chicken out there !!

This was my first time here: a takeout lunch of pad kee mao. Delicious! I ordered through Grubhub and my food was ready and hot when I arrived.

The only tricky thing was finding the parking lot. Approaching eastbound on 116th Street, I turned just before the building and ended up in someone else's parking lot. You have to pass the building first and then the parking is behind. Luckily there's a convenient back door.

Friendly service and great rockabilly music, but that's where it stops. 
I had the turkey dinner, and the turkey was bone dry despite being drowned in gravy. I might come back for drinks and live music, but not to eat.
Very good. The roasted duck and crispy tofu are especially delicious. It's a small place but the service is great. The staffs are friendly and knowledgeable when it comes to food selection.

My girlfriend has so many options near her apartment in Ucity. This place is one of her spots. I hear the service is good, but we had to do carryout #covid. 

I enjoyed the kimbap and udon stir fry. The stir fry was flavorful and saucy. The rice underneath the chicken katsu was mushy, and the katsu became soggy. However, I can't blame them for the sogginess because it's in a takeout container. I would come back and try out their options.

This is one of the best place to find tacos. The food is so fresh and so delicious. It is not that expensive as well. I always have shrimp and fish taco. The Chicken Chipotle Sope is so good. It is best dish i have ever had.

Add me to the growing pile of 5-star reviews! 

I ate Bua Loy 3 times in 5 days last week! YUM!

This is a family run business, and they put mega pride and love into their work. The food is delicious and high quality. The energy is very clean and positive here. It is a shining star on this curve of 30!

We've tried the following dishes:

Pad Khing (Stir fried with fresh ginger, garlic, onions, scallions, carrots, bell peppers and wood ear mushrooms).

Pho Ga (Chicken with noodles in a Vietnamese seasoned broth, onions, scallions, cilantro, bean sprouts, & jalapeños.)

Pho Tai (Beef steak slices with noodles in a Vietnamese seasoned broth, onions, scallions, cilantro, bean sprout, & jalapeños.)

Green Curry (Green Thai curry in coconut milk with green beans, carrots, and Thai basil.)

Late Night Noodle (Stir fried flat noodle with baby bok choy, carrot, and eggs in a shallot chili sauce.)

Larb Gai Salad (Laap is the national dish of Laos. Minced chicken salad with scallion, lime juice, chili, and fish sauce.)

No complaints about anything, although the Late Night Noodle and Green Curry were favorites. I think I am going to be stuck on that Late Night Noodle for a while (I've already repeated this order), which is kind of disappointing because there is a lot on the menu that I want to try. I just can't bring myself to get over those noodles. SOOOO good!

I could go into each and every dish, but there are too many to fit in this review. Let me just say that the meats are clean,

This is why you need me eating cheesesteaks!  You want me eating cheesesteaks!  A day of drinking and cheesesteak hit a high note.  We got the Leonardo and it moved us like a masterpiece should.  Flavorful seeded roll made in house.  Broccoli Rabe, Sharp provolone and long hots.  This was a sinus opener!  I don't think the roll should have been scooped.  Watch my video for more.  I scored it 94/100

The employees are always very nice and pleasant. The service is usually fast even though the parking lot is an accident waiting to happen. The food is usually pretty good, however the fries are soggy quite often. They get my order wrong probably 3 out of 10 times, which is too much. I don't really like having the employees taking my order outside. I feel rushed with them standing there looking at me and I can't really see the menu. There have also been issues with them not adhering to their closing times. I've definitely been to better Chick-Fil-a's and I've been to worse.

Great spot 
Get out and explore and it's awesome Charles and Matt took care of us 
Gotta go nice guys working hard ! 
Thanks for a great treat 
Andrew 
Fit4squash

As someone who enjoys fine dining, I searched for a restaurant that would fall in this category, coupled with live music, during my short trip to Nashville. 

From the moment we set foot inside the restaurant until we left, the entire experience was remarkable. The hostess that seated us was pleasant and our server (I wish I remember his name) was fantastic. It was a Sunday night and the band that performed was The Steve Roper Band. Excellent performers!!!

Everything we ordered tasted great. The portions were just right. Leave room for dessert!

Food was excellent. The pasta, fettuccini Alfredo, Had great sauce and chicken. Cooked perfectly! We also had a pepperoni pizza. The pizza was delicious as well as the garlic bread and the salad. The waitresses were great! The cooks behind the counter had masks I observed at least eight people ( mostly the men) with masks in, but all exposing their noses while preparing everyone's food! Although the food was excellent, I will not be returning to this restaurant as I am not willing to be exposed to Covid. A call to the health department is probably appropriate for this particular restaurant!
Amazing meal!! I ordered The Pollo Loco Sandwich on a wrap and it was so good! My daughter got the Miso soup and Carolina chicken wings. It was our first time there, but not our last.

Made a reservation online and requested the Rose Lounge, but when we arrived, they said it was too busy.  I wish they wouldn't tell people to make requests on the reservation, if they aren't able to make it happen.  We sat upstairs which ended up being okay, because there was an amazing view!  We only had drinks while we were in which were soooo delicious.  Highly recommend the Frose!

Great quality pizza with fresh toppings and thin, but chewy crust. Picked up takeout a couple times and it has never disappointed.  Look forward to trying their other pizzas. 
 
Garlic knots: 4/5
Supreme: 5/5
Old South: 5/5

we went for weekend lunch and it was a game day restaurant was full pack and filled with people to watch a game..They have nice bar, outdoor service also..we ordered burger two different vegetarian option from multiple but they did not have fries free we had to order it separately oue waiter was very friendly and best at his service i forgot this name needed to mention it was really nice..I am giving 4 star only its big costly for two ppl but nice place....
The food was great, the service was even better. Anthony was amazing!  Atmosphere was great, even in current conditions.
We have dinner here once or twice a week. Our bartender Chelsee takes care of all our every need. Really the best we have ever had. She is an asset to this establishment.

Yummmmmm...my husband raves about this place and we finally got take out from here the other weekend.
We ordered a variety of items: jambalaya, shrimp po boy, fried cajun mac n cheese with crab, bacon and corn, 6 beignets and a slice of kings cake. 
Omg the shrimp po boy was delicious. Way better than anything I tried in New Orleans (prob trying the wrong places while I was there). Favorite thing I got. The fried mac. N cheese was also very delicious and came with the sweet bbq like dipping sauce. Kings cake was good but very doughy and beignets were good but also very doughy. Over food is great here! Would def. Come back and order more things in the future :)

Food is decent (not spectacular), but execution rather sloppy. We ordered towards the late pm and picked up with about 20 minutes to closing. The manager and the person preparing our to go order were not wearing masks!!!!!! I was frankly in shock, did not know how to react....when I ordered the food I had told the manager that this was our first meal out in months due to covid concerns. She assured me that they were observing cleanliness protocols over the phone, and yet they are not wearing masks when I picked up the order. We got to the hotel, threw away whatever we could not nuke/microwave, and the rest of it we really did not enjoy (we microwaved it all hoping to kill any contamination, yeah, we are paranoid, but times are crazy). I called the manager and she just asked me to trust her..........Sorry, but they need to be professional and diligent with covid protocols. People front and back of house need to wear masks or not be in a restaurant facing the public. Huge miss, at least for me, a humble customer. Sorry to have patronized this business.

With the COVID-19 pandemic, ordered food and picked it up. Was done when I showed up at the time they told me and the food was outstanding.
When the restrictions ease off and we're allowed to go back to restaurants please frequent this establishment. The food and drinks are amazing.  

Darrin Houck

Super fun and comfy casual place to have stiff drinks, great food (better than pub grub) and watch the game!  It's an excellent place to go where the prices are extremely reasonable and the hospitality by BRETT is fantastic. Pizza and apps are delish. I imagine the whole menu is. We will continue to frequent this place often!  Check it out!

Despite the covid 2nd wave this place is still popular as of 11/14/2020.  Tables were full but properly spaced so it seemed pretty safe. (We have been dining out weekly since July)

Food and service were very good. It's a little pricey but seems worth it especially since we have been dining out less freq

We shared the Buffalo shrimp appetizer and for entrees we ordered the prime rib and the braised short ribs.

Food was tasty across the board plus service and ambiance also very good. We recommend and will return

I haven't been here in a few years because the food was so bad last time. Based on this visit they have improved.  I ordered a roast beef po boy. It wasn't bad, had a good flavor. What I didn't like was you have to assemble the poboy your self. The may is in a squeeze bottle on the table, the lettuce, tomato and pickle come on the side and there was hardly any gravy at all on the po boy.  Once assembled it was ok. It would have been better if you could evenly spread the mayo and with some gravy.

Went with two family members.  Ordered the small pull ball and board special.  We were impressed with the ball.  Great idea.  The special was hot, seasoned well, and tender.  

The service was friendly and quick.  It was not busy since we got there between lunch and dinner. 

This is a small place, but we found a place to eat.  

Look forward to the next trip.

Place is mostly hype and once you get past the giant root beer floats, the food is pretty ordinary.  They don't prepare "to go" orders.  The excuse was that preference was given to guests who dine in.  Service generally slow and most of the servers don't seem happy to be working there.

Our group was made up of 3 adults and one child.  We went on a Wednesday morning around 11:30 and had no trouble getting a table.  Even at that early time, the place was over half full.  It's one giant room with tanks along the one wall where you can pick what you want, from eel to lobster to fish and crab. All the Staff could not have been nicer.

We were there to try their Dim Sum, which is served from 9:30 til 3 and were so into eating the many dishes that we picked from the carts, that I forgot to take pictures.  From various stuffed dumplings, eggplant stuffed with shrimp, egg rolls to fresh Chinese broccoli tops, to other noodle dishes, the food kept coming and we kept enjoying.

To be truthful, we really weren't sure what some of them were but we tried maybe 10 or 11 and all were very good.  Of course we asked about some but half the fun of Dim Sum is trying things you might not otherwise try. What we enjoyed would not even put a dent into the amount of great looking items that were being brought around, so a few more visits are definitely planned.

For the above, with hot tea, the bill before tip came to around $50.  It's a BYO.  A very fun experience.
Great brunch location with interesting beer menu and outdoor seating. We've been pretty lucky to catch this place before it gets crowded on weekends for brunch. definitely recommend!

I used to eat lunch here often before the world got weird.  Got my 1st to go order 6 oz steak - it was delicious but what impressed me more was the distance they have gone to ensure safety with everyone wearing masks and cleaning tables that already looked spotless.  Great food, great service and great concern for public health.  Thank You!!! Yummy food time!!!

Wow!  Chicken tacos are amazing but the fried chicken salad was even better.  What a creation - fried chicken was off the charts mixed with corn bread crumbles, pumpkin seeds, cranberries and the herb ranch sauce. Kudos to the Chef!!!!

I'm back in the area this week and thought I'd give it another try after the disappointments 2 weeks ago.  The good news is the waitress was fast, friendly and attentive.  On the other hand, my beer came from the bar at the same time my entree was delivered.  The bartender was alone, so apparently was not able to keep up...  I had the Rib special, which wasn't outstanding, but ok.  My real complaint is that you advertise "Miller Lite Pints" for $2.95-"All Day-Every Day" with a $1.00 increase for a 23oz, but after I paid the check and then looked it over, I was charged $4.50 for the pint and $1.25 extra for a 23 oz..  Again the manager didn't appear to be present and certainly not on top or aware of the pricing and POS programming.  There was no bad weather to blame this time.
I am amazed that in these difficult times that this is how this restaurant operates.

This is actually some of the best boba I've had in a while. It's creamy and the boba is smaller than normal boba but cooked well and is the perfect texture. In addition, they make really good pizza that is inexpensive and fresh. The owner is also incredibly kind and really cares about putting out a quality product.

Never had a good experience at any location. The food is terrible. Only had maybe a decent appetizer but the rest of the food has always been subpar. And the service in many of them has been so terrible i should have never had to pay for the food.

Had a great time last night. We had 13 in our party and the staff were friendly & accommodating.  Our service while bowling was great, food was delicious.  The bar was very busy but our bartender, Sarah was amazing.  She made us feel so welcome. Drinks were perfect, kept checking back on us and made our experience fun.  We will definitely be back!

I have to update my review because when I first came here it was freshly reopening and they only had one thing on the menu basically. But I came back and OMG what a difference. There is a full menu now! I ordered the Hawaiian steak and creamed spinach and it was AMAZING! I was skeptical about ordering a ribeye from a catfish restaurant but I made the right choice! I also retried the potato salad and it was really good! There are so many things on the new menu I want to try! Will definitely be back soon. 

This goes without saying but the catfish here is legendary! Obviously!

The food was great, I got the fried green tomatoes (which I don't really like but I liked theirs) and the Nachos. But it took at least an hour for us to get our food. It wasn't even that crowded that day. I would come back. Our waitress and the manger was nice enough to give us a discount for the long wait. Highly recommend to come here.
We really enjoyed our first visit. The staff was exceptional and the restaurant was very clean. I was craving moros rice and it did not disappoint. Looking forward to our next visit.

Wow - haven't taste such delicious ice cream in so long!Ordered strawberry cheesecake and banana ice cream, and they were delicious. The quality and homemade taste brought me back to the excellent quality of Italy (if that makes any sense). Just sooooo incredible that we came here for seconds. Plus - love the vintage cars peeks out front!
Hey it's IHOP. Excellent service and was offered hot syrup to boot. Yummers. The waitstaff could not have been more friendly. Lucky to have IHOP in Mt Juliet!
Great authentic Afghan dishes and wonderful service.  Try this little gem.  The prices are very reasonable too.

This place is the college student's favorite late night snack! Basically all of WashU knows about John's. They're usually open at the hours of 11:00PM-12:00PM, so it's the perfect place to stop by if you're craving a donut late at night. (I did notice their hours changed on google, not sure if that's a permanent thing or due to the current coronavirus pandemic)

A lot of random and interesting decorations fill the store (a lot of superman). There are several tables in the shop. Street parking is usually plentiful.

Their donuts are amazing! They make my all time favorite classic glazed donut, which are pillowy and soft. I also really recommend the butter twist donut, which is very similar to the classic glazed donut. Also their apple fritters are really good, and probably what they are best known for! They also have cake donuts, old-fashion donuts, and some desserts like brownies to choose from.

Note: you can only use a card if the order is over $5
Really busy at lunch so make sure you're not in a hurry. Spicy miso was delicois. The pork bun appetizers and gyoza were fire

This adorable little coffee shop/deli is the perfect spot to grab a tasty meal and cup of coffee or espresso beverage. It's great for grab-and-go style, but there's also ample seating if you'd like to sit and enjoy your selections in house. They offer both healthy and indulgent breakfast treats like quiche, frittata, breakfast burritos, smoothies, fresh fruit, and pastries. 

I've had the quiche, frittata, breakfast burrito, and a scone and they were all amazing. I also tried their chia seed pudding and it was so so soooo good! The ingredients were clearly listed as well, which I always enjoy. It's refreshing to know what you're eating. 

Service is always quick, friendly, and accommodating, and I'm always greeted quickly and with a smile. 

Although I was only in the area for a short while, I know I'll make a point of coming here in the future if I'm anywhere near this adorable cafe.

Consistently high quality steaks, seafood and lighter fare too. Try the au poivre cheesesteak (three different steak cuts, and which comes with their amazing fries) for something new--at 20 bucks, it's roughly twice what you'd pay for a "standard" csteak, but easily 10 times better, and a filling meal!

What a gem! Great food, fun location and fast service. This was such a fun discovery this weekend as we were exploring the Architecture Repurpose shops and Antique Stores in the area. I ordered a chicken Quesadilla and my husband had a brisket burrito. Both orders came with crispy homemade chips and incredibly fresh salsa. We added guacamole because who wouldn't! The chicken & brisket where amazing!!You can taste the owners Deep South Texas and northern Mexican roots in every bite. The portions were huge so needless to say we couldn't finish every bite. I'm already looking forward to these leftovers, yummmmm!

Food and service were friendly and homey! What a hidden Gem. Loads of great beers to boot! Take road less traveled and check it out.

 Sierra Cowboy Sandwich

ST. LOUIS LAMBERT INT'L AIRPORT 07/09/19 DINNER

+The wings are on point; fried crispy and you can split the sauces.  The dry rub was nice, as well as, the house-made barbecue.
+The Smoky Parmesan Dusted Fries were okay, but I did not get the smokiness.
+The drink and food menu is pretty good for airport bars/grills.

-It would be nice to see some St. Louis BBQ options on the menu.

Overall, I would return to this restaurant when traveling for work.
The food was amazing and the service was good. However it was uncomfortably cold in there...maybe that was just me.

I hate it when people say "hidden gem" for some reason, but this place truly is a hidden gem. We happened upon this place and the burgers are so, so good and the prices are affordable. We spent $11 on two burgers and fries. Delicious. Luckily there is seating outside as inside is small and cramped. The bathroom was dirty and gross and was afraid to someone was going to try and walk in while using the restroom due to the wonky door which opens straight into the dining area. But hey, what are you going to do? I will just have to pee before I go. Will definitely be going back. Extra delicious.

Quite possibly the best bbq in St Louis, and an excellent location as well.  Ribs were incredible.  

The chopped brisket cheese steak sandwich was also spectacular.  Super excited about this place, and David hasn't even opened the Skullery private dining room yet.

Calling all happy hour enthusiasts! Valanni is the spot to be after work when a cocktail is calling. I'm talking liquid courage in ALL forms: we got $5 rotating specialty cocktails, red/ white/ rose/ AND sparkling wines, and beer. $5 munchies including truffle fries, mussels, and empanadas. Add outdoor seating and sprinkle in some of Philly's finest people watching, and you've got yourself a solid Friday night.

The cocktails alone are worth a visit. You really can't beat a well-made $5 drink. They rotate their offerings from their specialty list. The night I visited was their take on a whiskey sour, a margarita, a mojito, and martini - the perfect variety! At the suggestion of my server, I ordered the mojito (garnished with rock candy - cute!). Just a few sips in, and I was feeling good. It was incredibly fresh and tasty, and the perfect accompaniment to a warm spring evening and the people watching in Midtown. When my friends arrived, we sampled the red mussels, truffle fries, empanadas, and crispy Brussel sprouts. Everything was tasty, though not particularly noteworthy. The Brussel sprouts in particular were a joke. It was a basically a bowl of diced green apple garnished in burnt Brussel sprout skins. There was not a SINGLE Brussel sprout to be found in the dish. It was flavorful, yet odd dish, and calling it Brussel sprouts is straight-up fake news. Would not order again, even for $5.

The service was weird. Despite being a pretty sizable group, our table seemed invisib

Cute little diner near the airport. It got busy and there is limited seating. I sat at the bar and still had excellent service! 

Blueberry pancakes were delicious with hash browns all the way! Keep in mind if those jalapeños!

Updating my review from our most recent visit on September  15th. My daughter was ASSAULTED at the restaurant by another table! The restaurant offered no apologies and didn't even acknowledge to us that it happened! Two waiters rushed over to the table that threw the item that hit my daughter on the head, but nothing was said. The floor manager Ernesto, never even came out! We were just finishing our main course and my gay daughter was so humiliated that she just got up and left. I just couldn't believe that the waiter still said nothing to us when he again came to our table. I figured that the offending table was just being rich poorly behaved BIGOTS.  I did not want to make a scene. I asked my husband to get the bill as I needed to use the restroom. As I was entering the restaurant, in the doorway a woman from another table started to call out "Pay your check!" I was so stunned I just stopped and stared. The waiters, service people and bus boys were forced to go around me. She said extremely loudly that she has been "watching our table all night and you don't want to pay your bill!" I basically ran to the restroom and just want to leave this horrible place! As I am leaving the building she starts back up very loudly saying "Pay your check!" I collect my things and leave my husband with my autistic daughter, extremely well behaved, to finish up. The ONLY person to apologize to me was a very kind busboy! As I go by the woman to leave she starts in again very loudly about my c

The staff here is more than helpful when choosing the best meal for you! They explain the varieties of heat to choose from, and are always super friendly! The tenders are incredible! They are juicy and crispy with just the right amount of spice (which is good considering you choose your own spice level)! Also do not sleep on the french fries, they are delicious and can hold their own! Overall, you are in for a lovely experience and some awesome chicken!

Will not be back. I wanted lasagna but my wife didnt  so we compromised on spaghetti and meatballs. I wanted Caesar salad and she didn't so we settled on mixed greens. So neither one of us got what we wanted because we had to share meals. And yes, we could have each gotten our own and taken it home. I wasn't going to spend that much on food tonight. Shareable meals should be an option. NOT MANDATORY!

Another visit another excellent dinner with fantastic service.  

We were at our favorite restaurant on 08/01/2019 to celebrate our wedding anniversary and our dear friend's birthday. 

The drive was difficult as we had record rainfall and vehicle accidents everywhere.  We left Weeki Wachee two hours before our reservation. The valet has parked our vehicle previously and he is the first very polite person you meet at the restaurant. Our guest was caught in the traffic mess and was 5 minutes late.  I informed the host our guest would be 5 minutes late and she was very sweet and said no problem just to let her know when the guest arrived.  It appeared many guests were running late as the front entrance was packed. 

Santiago was our waiter and he didn't miss anything!  Water glass not even 1/2 empty and he refilled it.  Soda glass refilled in the same manner.  When the wine glass had 1/4 left he asked if we wanted another.  Absolutely perfect, polite and very attentive service!  

For appetizers we had the lobster rolls, day boat scallops and shrimp cocktail.  All were absolutely perfect!  The waiter saw us close our menus and he knew we were ready to order.  He said he would space everything out so as to give us time to enjoy everything.  He was right and he spaced everything out perfectly.  

As always the salad and French onion soup were both perfect!  The attention to detail is second to none.  We all had steaks.  Our friend and I both had the Filet Mignon while my wife had
Awesome scratch breakfast with a beautiful view! Great way to spend a morning with my son, only 14 mins from The College of New Jersey campus!

Hot AND new on Bourbon St. definitely did not disappoint. Enjoy cold beer & daquiris as the sign suggests to wash it all down!

Their Cajun Willie, Peppy Willie and Buffalo Willie pizzas by the slice were all we expected + more!

Generously sized slices good to eat normally or by folding in half if necessary. Amazing crust to finish. Any 2 beers for $7? Yes please!

A group of 6 of us went here for dinner for a birthday. We are all in the food/beverage industry and will always try to give a restaurant every reason for why something might not go as planned. However, this was just bad. There was a 20 minute wait when we arrived at 6:45. We were seated by 7:00pm. We were so excited to try this place, as it does have such a great atmosphere. After we were seated, the server walked by us several times and after 20 minutes told us she would be right with us. At 7:45 she finally came over. 7:45! In hindsight, we should have left after no one greeted us for so long. We didn't get our drinks until 8:00pm. Needless to say, it went downhill from there. Every question asked, the servers response was, 'I don't know'. The bbq was dry and sides weren't much better. 
Mayyybe it was just a bad day for them, as they do have awesome reviews. I won't be back again to find out.
Estuve hace unos dias atras y ordene arrooz con pollo, la verdad ese dia me enferme era comida guardada "malograda" que pena lugares como este hacen  quedar mal a la gastronomic Peruana

First visit to Fox and Hound. We stopped in to catch a UFC event, as this was the nearest spot confirmed to be showing it. We were charged a $10 cover, and upon entry, found it was standing room only. You'd think that once every seat is filled, the restaurant would stop taking people, at least for fire safety and capacity restrictions. People continued to file in and just pile up, standing shoulder to shoulder. Nobody wanted to leave because they'd already paid the cover. It took 15 minutes to order a single drink. Overall, it was a very unpleasant experience and I won't be returning.

While there is a slight pretentiousness to this place, from the patrons, not the staff (but that's Wayne, and why I kinda like it)...the food is really really good.  we've been there a couple of times.  for light bites and full meals and have always been happy.  It is pricey, but when the food and service are good we are willing to pay more.
great pizza & great prices! everyone is very nice there too definitely a good late night pizza place as well

Found this GEM by accident my favorite kind!
Anything with the words caffeine and a drive through is definitely for me.
This place is fabulous from the menu to the service.
I ordered the most delicious ham egg lemon aioli biscuit that was as delicious as it was filling. 
I also ordered a croissant because well it's a croissant and OH EM GEE!!!! Flaky warm perfection was what I received - I would go daily for their croissants!
Ok now to the good stuff the cawfee - I got a cold brew with a splash of oat milk and it was delicious and hit the spot.  I was out early and was on only 1 cup that could get dangerous so you know - this hit the spot!

This is my second time here and the menu looked like it had changed quite a bit in the couple years since my last visit. I am gluten-free and vegan, and I was able to replace seitan with tofu and there are several began and gf options. I ordered the Tacos which were oily but pretty good especially with the cashew sour cream. I also ordered the East African Curry and I was so disappointed. It has almost no flavor at all and didn't smell very appetizing. My server Suzanne was very helpful and understanding. She made the whole experience more pleasant. I sent back the curry and got the Pad Thai at Suzanne's recommendation. It's spicy and yummy so I'm happy! Since they change the menu I may return in the future.

Their no-touch carryout setup is ideal.   You call in your order, pay over the phone, and tell them what time you want to pick it up.   You pull up in your vehicle next to a big folding table.    You are greeted by a masked employee who asks for the name on your order.    They run inside and bring out your hot and cold items in separate bags.   (the case of beer and fresh produce was obviously in a fridge).

The takeout menu is perfect.    There are a lot of pantry items and produce available.   You can order large trays of cooked meats and family meals.   There is a limited, but well-thought out selection of individual meals too.    And if course there is the beer - available in cans or growlers (growlers provided by them - they will not refill growlers at this time for sanitary reasons).   Growlers can be returned at a later date and you get $4 back.

Other restaurants could learn a lot from Big Lug about how a carryout operation should be run.

We live within walking distance, and we eat out fairly often, so pre-COVID-19 we used to hit up Maloney's two or three nights per week. I absolutely love their chicken and veggies entree and the bowl version with rice. I missed it more than I imagined while they were closed.

Today we had our "first meal" out in the real world after restaurants were allowed to reopen at limited capacity, and Maloney's did not disappoint. Slightly weird with so few tables inside, but everything was great and it was so nice to see people out and about again!

Thinh An is everything you want in a Vietnamese restaurant and bakery. Ambience is clean and crowded, but customer service in the dining area manages it all well. Food is tasty as well. 

Tip: Even though they have signs about wearing masks, they don't really social distance. So if you're trying to get in and out, get take out. 

My friends and I got seated right away, tucked in the back booth for me and my kid, which was nice. We all got different things and they were all delicious. They increased the prices on some of their popular items like their soups. 

I ordered a Bun Bo Hue with everything, large fresh sugar cane drink, and large durian smoothie (fresh fruit +$1.50). Later, I went to the bakery side and got 2 baos, and 1/2 gallon pandan soy milk ($3). Before tip, I paid about $30 for everything. Not bad for good Vietnamese food and drinks that is hard to find in Tampa. 

Overall, love this place for its simplified and easy to read menu (includes pics, descriptions, and prices), open buffet style bakery (not covid safe bc most items aren't individually wrapped like the baos), and fridge full of sweets and fresh drinks.

Just simply awesome. From the 4 Hands Pi Pizzeria ale, to the garlic bread with actual roasted garlic that you spread on, to the deep dish cornmeal crust pizza with the best pizza sauce I have ever had, this experience was what a pizza parlor should be. Plus, prompt, friendly wait staff. When in St. Louis, we will be returning.

This is a great spot! Their staff is super friendly, especially their bar staff. The food is great and there are always new items to try! The outside is definitely awesome during the summer months... having music, fruity drinks, and a nice summer breeze. I would recommend everyone visits at least a few times before they make a judgement call... being in the industry before there is always an off night and I feel like some of these reviews are  a result of that! Love this place!

I've been a customer for many many year. I buy Caviar ever two weeks. Today I ask for fresh salmon caviar that hasn't had the spoon sitting in it. They refused to get fresh out of the back...Seriously??? This is $58.00 a pound and they wouldn't give me fresh product. POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE.

Amazing.  Can't wait to go back.  The lunch portions are huge the soup is to die for.  Will post photos next time around 
Get the fettuccine with the fresh crab and spinach, you won't be disappointed

THE BEST FRIED CHICKEN IN THE STATE OF LOUISIANA. My favorite biscuit of all time! This place is always packed. Wait times can be long, but I've never felt like it wasn't worth it! The chicken has the perfect amount of spice and crunch. The biscuit is buttery and soft. I get sad when I finish it. It's definitely worth getting an extra. I also love their chicken tenders. They're huge and juicy. Not a fan of the 2 sauce options they have which are bbq and honey mustard. I used to love going on fridays when the shrimp etouffee is served! I also like their hamburger steak. This is a hidden gem. They're an old Popeyes location so they even have a drive thru. I will forever wish they were open on weekends since I don't live in the area anymore. I can't imagine disliking anything from here. Go ahead and change your life and check it out.

Went for lunch this week. We absolutely loved the place. We had the Tiger Roll, Yummy Roll and Spicy Tuna roll. We loved the Tiger Roll so much we asked for it again. It was so good. Will definitely return again.
Every time i go to Bahama Breeze i always get the jerk wings and I'm always happy i did so. They're very tend, moist and seasoned well not to spicy but has some kick.

Coming back from a Miami trip, we had some really good lobster rolls and we were on a quest to find some in Tampa. Yelp reviews were good for this place, so we thought we would give it a try. The place is very fishy smelling when you walk in, also don't expect to be impressed by the interior. I started with the clam chowder which was way too salty for my taste. We then ordered the UConn rolls with potato salad. The rolls were perfectly toasted with butter, but the lobster was chewy, over cooked and under seasoned. Some of the lobster meat had a green tinge to it, which turned me off, so I ended up leaving most of it on the plate. The potato salad had a good flavor. We drove about 45 mins to get here, but I don't think we would make the drive again.  Still on a good lobster roll quest in the Tampa area!

In town for a conference at the Marriott, this place is super close walk. Had such a great experience the first night, came back the second night.  Great happy hour specials, great tasting food, and great beer.  I recommend the Philly IPA and the sweet potatoes fries.

Sat at the bar both nights and had complete different folks serving me on each night, and the primary reason I'm writing this review is to praise the level of service and friendliness of the bar staff.  They were great, offering to let me try any beer before purchasing a full one.  They just really went above and beyond to make sure I had a great experience.  

This place just to me exemplifies what a gastropub should be and when I find myself traveling to Philly, I'll be swinging by again.
Overdue on the review. I love this place. Food is affordable & delicious. Everyone is friendly. My favorite is belly of the beast, wandering pig & ukoy.
Great sandwiches and Salads. Freshly sliced meats. Oven fresh breads. Attentive quick service. Delivery service is great as well.

I was surprised to find this not so little cafe and breakfast house. It is spacious inside, soft music and nicely put together. 

I don't eat meat and so the Manager was happy to swap it out for their grits, which I was happy to get.

The free cinnamon roll for checking in was not available, so again the Manager said I could have another dessert. I was drawn here due to the 5 star reviews. 

It's so nice to see this area coming back to life and felt very comfortable. 

I had the Pancake plate and it was simple and good. Nothing fancy, but then neither is the price. You should give them a try!
always good food an service, been multiple timrs, usually always get the hot shrimp, the lobster tails and crab fries,

This is the place to go for breakfast when stopping through Indiana for race weekend. They have a diverse menu with something for everyone! I love pancakes. You'll love them too. They have eggs-ellent omelets. The coffee is plentiful. Huge portions! (You may just see Indy 500 winners dining here as well. Mr. Foyt was here when my family stopped in for breakfast.)

Very good pizzas with the combination of the Arugula salad. I wasn't expecting it but this restaurant has good pizzas and desserts and it was definitely enjoyable. The best part of this entire lunch experience was my dessert.  I ordered the Butter Cake with ice cream. I vote this dessert the best I've had out of many places. I hope this butter cake tastes just as good every time.  I'm coming back for both. The butter cake was deliciously warm and melts in your mouth. The combination with the ice cream heightens the experience ten times. The ice cream had lite crunches and combined with the soft butter cake was great. Will definitely come back. Thank you.

This restaurant is sooooo good and all of the dishes are memorable. All of the food is executed so well. If you want elegant, really good food, this is the place. The ambience is more of a 3 star. Beautiful but something about it, maybe the glass looking out onto busy Howard, just makes it a little ordinary. The bartenders are nice if you need to wait. Helpful and eager to educate if you have any questions. The bar area is really small so it is limiting if you like to sit at the bar and socialize for a long while. It's a pricey meal, but I think you will find it worth every morsel. I should also mention that the menu changes so your favorite from last time might not be on the menu the next time.
Came for lunch.  Great atmosphere, right on beach.  Smoked fish spread was awesome!  And who can resist an adult drink served in a bucket?!

Whenever I'm craving a good bagel, my mind instantly goes to Bagel Cafe. It's a known staple here in IV and there is almost always a long line. Walking past Bagel Cafe, you can always smell it and it is just so good!! The wait is maybe 15 minutes after you order. Because of COVID, you do have to wear a mask inside when ordering. 

I ordered Fire in the Hole which is bacon turkey and avocado (a personal favorite classic combination) with a SUPER spicy sauce/salsa? I got the sauce on the side because it's a bit too spicy for me so I like to have the option to put as little or as much as I want. It definitely fulfilled all my cravings - SO SATISFIED! Even putting a small amount makes it a decent spice level. The flavors and the bagel are just perfect to me. If only they could make the sauce a bit less spicy, it'd be perfect!

The price for the sandwich (~8.50) is decent and fair, especially since the bagel (in my opinion) is pretty filling. I'm a Bagel Cafe superfan!!

Let me start by saying that Jewel, prior to Covid, (& hopefully after), was a fantastic bar. Truly, one of our favorites. However, I was extremely disappointed at the lackluster "Cocktail Experience". To bill this as an "experience" is exceptionally misleading. An experience implies something out of the ordinary, and this was anything but. First, I felt that the usually beautiful space was somewhat unkempt; it's a Carnival celebration, but Christmas decorations are definitely still up. Second, we ordered drinks from the menu, but there was no "story" behind the drinks or connection to the "carnival" theme.  The drinks were good, but not exceptional. Finally, the "snacks" were very disappointing - the pimento cheese gougere felt stale and although the shrimp remoulade was tasty, it was served with a few (maybe 6?) Zapp's chips. Again, the snacks had zero connection to the Carnival theme advertised through Jewel's Instagram and website. 

I understand that our bars and restaurants are doing the best they can during this Pandemic, and I am grateful for the chance to support our favorite places, but this fell really short for me. For nearly $50 a person, I expected a bit more Carnival spirit, southern hospitality, and charm.
Best pizza in Florida. We enjoy this place tremendously. So much reminded us of the north end in Boston. All you New englanders try this place you will love it.

If I was giving a review for the food alone I would give it 5 stars. The food was REALLY delicious. However, there was quite a few instances where the service was not very good, maybe even straight up BAD!!! I will preface this review by saying we had 10 guests in our party.

First, my friend ordered the "Tofu Baker" which, the sauce was good and had a lot of flavor  but the tofu was literally like 3 brick-sized pieces of tofu and thus did not absorb any flavor. So although the sauce was good, overall it wasn't a good dish at all. So she ordered something else and had her food wrapped up because she didn't feel like making a big deal and having it taken off the check. Later, after the meal she asked if they could just take the takeout box and throw it out because we were going out to another place afterwards and she didn't want to take her crap food home anyways. So then, one of the managers comes over and is like "do you want us to take this off the bill? Because like sometimes people want us too take it off the check, but it's not our fault that you chose to order that..." ...... which is so rude! And what is the manager even talking about?? Obviously the customer wouldn't order the dish he/she knew it would be BAD. So anyways she just said no thank you I'll still pay I just don't want the food. Pretty weird if you ask me. 

The next issue was that after everybody's food came out, mine didn't. So after waiting for like 8 minutes hoping maybe it was still cooking, I asked th

Many think that you have to compromise when it comes to vegan food, but that is NOT the case at Olivers! The food is amazing and certainly does not lack in flavor. The food here is certainly worth going to check out regardless of whether your a meat or plant eater! Not to mention the atmosphere at the restaurant invites you to stay for hours, enjoying your time among friends, coworkers, etc. This restaurant is simply beautiful from the modern yet rustic and comfortable feel.

Interesting small plates and great wine/ beer selection. Came for lunch, and while it was a bit pricey for lunch each food item was delish. Large selection of salumi and cheeses. Great views out back.  Friendly staff.  Definitely worth a try... it feels like a big city restaurant in the heart of New Hope.

Went back recently and the quality has dipped. Since The owner, Selena and her husband, are focusing on their new venture on the Mainline it's not quite the same. We tried to order from their special menu in Chinese; however, they didn't honor some of the items and prices since the owner's not there. I also found a long piece of hair when I opened my naw mai gai (lotus leaf rice wrap) and it's def not mine since I have short hair. If the owner's not there, avoid this place.

My wife and I visited Sunny's solely based on Yelp ratings. We we actually heading to Popeyes in Greenwood area.  I looked at the ratings on Yelp and they were terrible!  Poor service, bad attitudes, incorrect orders, and the straw that broke the camels back - one post stated the place was filthy. We don't need filthy in the midst of the virus pandemic.  I checked a couple other Popeye locations and ratings were just as poor. Basically small pieces of chicken, poor service, and long wait times. So, I checked KFC locations and more of the same. 2 star ratings were the norm. Sunny's has a yelp rating of 4.5 so we decided to give their carry out a try. Food was hot, delicious, and more than enough. They give you the whole chicken breast, not half, like their competitors. If you are an average eater the two piece mixed is more than enough. Don't order the large mash potatoes, the small one is enough. I also had the Okra side which was excellent. In summary, great food, large portions, friendly staff. They are a bit pricier than their competitors and it took about 40 minutes for them to fill our order (because it's cooked to order and not sitting under a heat lamp for hours on end), but as the old adage goes "you get what you pay for".  First time Sunny's Customer.  We will be back. Good job!'

My husband and I dined in here because of the good recommendations we got from our friends, and we left the place in utter disappointment. We were so excited for the walnut shrimp and the food just didn't seem like it was freshly cooked. It had a soggy texture and was not appealing to our tastebuds at all. The only thing we enjoyed about that dish were the walnuts and the broccoli. The fried rice was bland in taste. 

I'm giving two stars because the only ones that tasted good were the shumai and the fried wings. I have no complaints about the service we received.

Food trucks come to my business office every Friday but the whole building knows when Heavy is around. Best soul food in Tampa! Best prices and excellent service. Heavy (owner) is very friendly and knows southern hospitality!

This place is an awesome neighborhood bar that happens to have some really great food! The service is always fast and friendly. I've tried a few different items from the menu and haven't picked a bad one yet. Great place to wind down after work or to catch up with old friends.
The ceviche was covered in ketchup and served w saltine crackers. The fish tacos were extremely salty to the point of not being able to eat them. The atmosphere was cool.

Working an event at SLU, prefer as usually and was told no special request were allowed with my order, simply asked for a side of pepper to go along with my sandwich. Completely rude the manager denied me and my party of 8 to get an additional ingredient after we said we would pay for them. Very bad energy and vibes from this establishment, a college campus don't waste your time here, go else where!
Their pizza is so delicious, my favorite is the upside down pie is amazing. The cheesesteak egg rolls are some of my favorite. Great service always polite and nice delivery drivers. Give them 5 stars

Delicious vegan comfort food! The Big Mak tastes EXACTLY like a Big Mac! I also got the crack tacos, which were very very good and served with vegan ranch. My only complaint was it was a bit expensive, but really that's only in comparison to the non-vegan versions. They also have a few non-vegan options for your meat eating friends, which is honestly nice because usually it's the other way around. That way everyone can have a tasty option. I have to go back for the toasted ravioli because I hear amazing things.

This place completely ruined our dinner, and there's no way I'd recommend it to anyone. 

We planned to be in Philly for my birthday, so after doing some research I decided to make reservations at IndeBlue to celebrate. When we walked in, there was no one inside to instruct us where to sit. After waiting a few minutes, we were met with the coldest "Can I help you?" from the hostess. We were led to our table, which was awkwardly positioned in the middle of the main dining room indoors. They do get credit for spacing out tables during the pandemic, we just happened to get what seemed to be the worst table in the restaurant. 

20 minutes went by from the moment we sat down to the moment our waiter came over. When he did, we asked if there was outdoor seating, and he said he was going to go check. Right after, I saw him walk to the bar of the restaurant and make drinks for 15 mins, before coming back and saying there weren't tables outside. By that time, it had been over 30 mins of us sitting around, without even having the water we had asked for earlier. 

While all of this is happening, random staff were walking around (nose completely uncovered) giving out an insanely small cup of soup, part of the dining experience on the weekends. No description of what it was - they just placed it on our table. 

Important to note that on the weekends you can only dine with a fixed menu for $35/per person. 

45 mins into dinner and we still didn't have the bottle of wine we ordered. When ou
Straight up best indian restaurant in all of santa barbara. Tried Bibiji multiple times, flavor of india, Masala Spice is our favorite!!! Get the chicken tikka masala and samosas

All of the stars. 
My friend and I shared the farmer's cheese with pita, the chicken cigars, cauliflower, carrots, and lamb meatballs and enjoyed some cocktails. I was stuffed when we left and the flavors were spectacular. There was not a disappointing dish. Highly recommend and I'll definitely return!

During COVID-19, all Sahm's locations have pivoted to become a pantry and marketplace. This includes Sahm's Ale House in the Village of West Clay in Carmel. 

Each location has a slightly different menu with various offerings, but the concept is the same across the board. Call in your order, pay over the phone and pick-up your grocery order curbside.

I've been avoiding grocery stores during COVID-19, and online ordering through big companies like Amazon is hit or miss. With Sahm's, there's no guesswork of what's in stock AND I'm supporting a local business in my community. Not to mention, you can order and pick-up same day - no waiting!

The gal who took my order over the phone was super nice and read my order back to me. Since this was my first time using their curbside grocery service, she explained the setup. I told them my car color/model and when I pulled up to the restaurant, they brought all my things out and set them on the patio table. It is a no-contact process, so they are unable to put it in your car - which is fine by me! I took my box and was on my way.

The selection includes prepared food from their limited menu (salads, burgers, tenderloins, etc.) and family-style meals ideal for 4-6 people. The grocery list includes a decent list of fresh fruit and vegetables, meat, dressings and sauces, pantry staples, baked goods (hello, sour cream coffee cake!) and even cleaning supplies. YES, they have disinfectant, toilet paper and paper towel! All at reasonable prices

Use to be a really good place, but now it seems like they are getting lazy and to comfortable.  I placed an order on a Saturday morning and it was TERRIBLE, I think the manager was off or something because the blueberry pancakes had no real blueberries like usual, they should be ashamed for serving the bacon that I received with my order, and the food was just not good.  I would not recommend this place to anyone.  I will not be returning.
Loved it here for lunch overlooking the park. Bellini, mussels, french fries and warm shrimp salad= heaven

I've been jonesing for this Chef Salad after exploring much of the rest of the menu over the past 3 years. It did not disappoint. Although $13 after tax and tip due to Covid pricing like everywhere else, it was well spent. After I chopped it up it was the perfect salad. No complaints here and can't think of any way to improve it. Perfect portion size (i.e. almost couldn't finish it) ratios, balance and no scrimping on the various fresh ingredients. As always, service was attentive, hospitable and impeccable.

It's crazy and wonderful that this place exists. They're not just incredible because they're the only place open late (and very at that!)-the food also tastes great, tons of options, and fast, reliable delivery. Very happy to have discovered this late night gem!

If you're vegan, don't eat anywhere else! This is legit vegan food! I'm from Portland, Oregon, which is pretty much the vegan capital of the US so vegan restaurants here have been a let down compared to what I'm used to, this place is the exception. I have been in New Orleans for 4 days, and this is the first time I have felt like I have eaten real food! Highly recommend the chik'n cheese steak, or beyond burgers!

Wow I love this place. The food is amazing and their salsas are to die for. Drinks are great too. I got the lobster tacos and they are really good. Would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting

A friend of mine & I do a yearly  "Vegan Week". This year looked a little different as we kept it very simple because of Covid. We knew we had to try out this raved about restaurant & it did not disappoint. We order togo and waited at the restaurant while it was being prepared. The bartender offered us drinks while we waited but we decided to wait until we were home. Togo Margaritas are truly a thing of beauty! The bartender strained the ice so that it wouldn't be watered down by the time we got home. The mushroom carpaccio was definitely my favorite, entree & the chocolate fudge bar was PHENOMENAL! By far one of the best restaurants throughout of 5 years of yearly vegan weeks!
Outstanding sandwiches! We highly recommend a Mom's PLT and the pastrami Reuben. Staff were friendly and they are following Covid guidelines.  To go only.

Came here with a friend on a whim after a yoga class. Service wasn't really that good so that's why I'm taking a star off. Waitress didn't give us napkins, no straws, no utensils. We had to ask and remind her for each thing and it was extremely hard to grab her since it was super busy. The food made things worth it, gotta come back for Sunday unlimited brunch. All you can eat for 18$ and unlimited mimosas? Count me in. . Tacos were great.
I had the great fortune to have dined with a friend this morning at First Watch. They went out of their way to make our dinning experience unique! Delicious food in an inviting environment!

When this little hot spot first opened I was pretty darn impressed. The location is convenient and it's easy to just pop in quick and grab a bite, or you can sit on the spacious patio space donned with gas fireplace heaters and plenty of tables. Step inside, and you will notice a nice, clean, open  and modern floor plan. No frills, but nice. There is always a load of employees with vibrant energy behind the counter and the food came out very quickly.....almost superhero quick! AND....the best part was it was fresh, had some great flavors going on, and the portions were perfect....not too much, but just enough to fill you up and worth the effort to stop in. The prices are phenomenal too! I kept going back and was satisfied exactly the same each time, until this past week. I was super bummed to get my Fried Cod and Fried Shrimp tacos only to discover they were not crispy, but quite soggy as if they were prepared ahead of time and they sat for a while under a heat lamp. Advice.....keep doing what you WERE doing. There is no need to rush a good thing. Your timing was just fine in the beginning and certainly quick enough!!!! Please, I beg you to cook the food on the spot and never let it sit!! I will continue my visits and hope that my advice is merited and considered.
Very good food and excellent waitress.  Will definitely go back when we are in the area!

Got the family meal to go and everyone loves it. I'm so picky about boneless wings. These are easily in my top 5 places ever. Really really good food. Can't wait to come back and try something different.

When I still attended UCSB and my mom would come to visit, this was the breakfast place we ALWAYS had to have! We would get a breakfast bagel sandwich and a Sex on a Bagel both to split. The Sex in a Bagel is a MUST! For those of you who do not know what that is, it's a cinnamon glaze bagel. 

I have had the PB & J bagel and the Eggel breakfast bagel sandwich. But, today I decided to enjoy the Chicken salad bagel sandwich. It was very good. I wasn't expecting the cranberries in the chicken salad mixture, but I enjoyed it as it added a simple sweetness to it all. For all of your sandwiches you can order it from a variety of different fresh bagels! 

Watch out because the line is always VERY long and there is not a lot of sitting. If you bring a blanket then you can enjoy your meal on the park that is right next to the place. Also if you're driving beware that there is only street parking in a college town, so finding a close space is rare.
